title: Third Party Risk Assessment
description: Third Party Risk Assessment contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: docubricks-fs-third-party-risk-assessment
  title: Third Party Risk Assessment
  description: Third Party Risk Assessment contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_third_party_risk_assessment_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/third_party_risk_assessment
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/third_party_risk_assessment
    sourceVersion: fs_third_party_risk_assessment_v1
    sourceDigest: f0e20c97bbaea63a6714a35757f32e5af9c00ae8378529bd097b336273ab84d3
spec:
  role: review
  pages:
    - id: main
      title: Third Party Risk Assessment
      sections:
        - id: dates-and-terms
          title: Dates And Terms
          description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: assessment-date
              name: assessment_date
              label: Assessment Date
              description: Date the assessment was completed.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
              required: true
            - id: vendor-service-description
              name: vendor_service_description
              label: Vendor Service Description
              description: Description of products or services provided.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: soc-report-date
              name: soc_report_date
              label: Soc Report Date
              description: Date or period end of SOC report.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
            - id: remediation-due-date
              name: remediation_due_date
              label: Remediation Due Date
              description: Due date for remediation if stated.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
            - id: next-review-date
              name: next_review_date
              label: Next Review Date
              description: Next periodic review date.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
        - id: document-details
          title: Document Details
          description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: criticality-tier
              name: criticality_tier
              label: Criticality Tier
              description: Critical, high, medium, low, or other tier.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: data-access-level
              name: data_access_level
              label: Data Access Level
              description: Customer data, confidential data, payment data, PHI, none, or other.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: outsourcing-indicator
              name: outsourcing_indicator
              label: Outsourcing Indicator
              description: Whether this is an outsourcing or material service provider.
              dataType: boolean
              widget: checkbox
            - id: subcontractors
              name: subcontractors
              label: Subcontractors
              description: Named material subcontractors or fourth parties.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: soc-report-type
              name: soc_report_type
              label: Soc Report Type
              description: SOC 1, SOC 2, bridge letter, none, or other.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: open-issues
              name: open_issues
              label: Open Issues
              description: Open issues, findings, or remediation items.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
        - id: financials
          title: Financials
          description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: inherent-risk-rating
              name: inherent_risk_rating
              label: Inherent Risk Rating
              description: Inherent risk before controls.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: parties
          title: Parties
          description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: vendor-name
              name: vendor_name
              label: Vendor Name
              description: Legal or operating name of the vendor.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: business-owner
              name: business_owner
              label: Business Owner
              description: Internal owner or relationship manager.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: customer-impact
              name: customer_impact
              label: Customer Impact
              description: Whether vendor failure could materially affect customers.
              dataType: boolean
              widget: checkbox
            - id: approver-name
              name: approver_name
              label: Approver Name
              description: Approver, committee, or risk officer.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: risk-and-compliance
          title: Risk And Compliance
          description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: residual-risk-rating
              name: residual_risk_rating
              label: Residual Risk Rating
              description: Residual risk after controls.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: information-security-rating
              name: information_security_rating
              label: Information Security Rating
              description: Information security control rating.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: business-continuity-rating
              name: business_continuity_rating
              label: Business Continuity Rating
              description: BCP/DR control rating.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: financial-condition-rating
              name: financial_condition_rating
              label: Financial Condition Rating
              description: Financial strength or viability rating.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: regulatory-compliance-rating
              name: regulatory_compliance_rating
              label: Regulatory Compliance Rating
              description: Compliance control rating.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: approval-status
              name: approval_status
              label: Approval Status
              description: Approved, conditionally approved, rejected, pending, or other.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
  validationRules:
    - id: vendor-name-present
      severity: error
      description: vendor_name is required for Third-party Risk Assessment extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: vendor_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: vendor_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: vendor_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(vendor_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: assessment-date-present
      severity: error
      description: assessment_date is required for Third-party Risk Assessment extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: assessment_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: assessment_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: assessment_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(assessment_date)) > 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      vendor_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Third-party Risk Assessment workflow.
      criticality_tier:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Third-party Risk Assessment workflow.
      residual_risk_rating:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Third-party Risk Assessment workflow.
      approval_status:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Third-party Risk Assessment workflow.
      assessment_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Required field for Third-party risk assessment extraction.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Third-party Risk Assessment documents combine structured fields and narrative risk/legal/compliance
      context.
  submissionSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      assessment_date:
        type: date
        description: Date the assessment was completed.
        format: date
      vendor_name:
        type: string
        description: Legal or operating name of the vendor.
      vendor_service_description:
        type: string
        description: Description of products or services provided.
      business_owner:
        type: string
        description: Internal owner or relationship manager.
      criticality_tier:
        type: string
        description: Critical, high, medium, low, or other tier.
      inherent_risk_rating:
        type: string
        description: Inherent risk before controls.
      residual_risk_rating:
        type: string
        description: Residual risk after controls.
      data_access_level:
        type: string
        description: Customer data, confidential data, payment data, PHI, none, or other.
      customer_impact:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether vendor failure could materially affect customers.
      outsourcing_indicator:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether this is an outsourcing or material service provider.
      subcontractors:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Named material subcontractors or fourth parties.
      soc_report_type:
        type: string
        description: SOC 1, SOC 2, bridge letter, none, or other.
      soc_report_date:
        type: date
        description: Date or period end of SOC report.
        format: date
      information_security_rating:
        type: string
        description: Information security control rating.
      business_continuity_rating:
        type: string
        description: BCP/DR control rating.
      financial_condition_rating:
        type: string
        description: Financial strength or viability rating.
      regulatory_compliance_rating:
        type: string
        description: Compliance control rating.
      open_issues:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Open issues, findings, or remediation items.
      remediation_due_date:
        type: date
        description: Due date for remediation if stated.
        format: date
      approval_status:
        type: string
        description: Approved, conditionally approved, rejected, pending, or other.
      approver_name:
        type: string
        description: Approver, committee, or risk officer.
      next_review_date:
        type: date
        description: Next periodic review date.
        format: date
    required:
      - assessment_date
      - vendor_name
    additionalProperties: false
    x-ladder-docubricks:
      completenessChecklist:
        - id: required_fields_present
          description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
          fields:
            - assessment_date
            - vendor_name
        - id: section_coverage_reviewed
          description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
          sections:
            - dates_and_terms
            - document_details
            - financials
            - parties
            - risk_and_compliance
        - id: nested_lists_normalized
          description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
          fields: []
